text.en:
■ Activates when using Burst Skill. Affects self.

■ Activates when attacking with Full Charge during Full Burst. Affects self.
Camouflage: Prevents being targeted by single-target attacks for {1} sec. This effect is removed upon taking a direct hit.
■ Activates only when in Camouflage status. Affects self.
Normal attacks deal true damage continuously.
True Damage ▲ {2}% continuously.

直接攻撃を受けると解除」

text.en:
■ Activates as long as this unit is alive.
AS Formation
Function: Issues advantageous combat tactics to the targets.
Effect 1: Affects all allies from the same squad. Critical Rate ▲ {1}% continuously.
Effect 2: Affects all allies. Charge Damage ▲ {2}% continuously.
Effect 3: Affects self. ATK ▲ {5}% continuously.

Bonus effects while this unit is in the LT Formation state:
Effect 1: Affects all allies. Projectile Explosion Damage ▲ {3}% continuously.
Effect 2: Affects all allies. True Damage ▲ {4}% continuously.
